The behaviour prompts use infinity and one-sided approach notation before explaining how to read it.
Before p4-identify, add: “x→∞ means x increases without bound; x→−∞ means x becomes increasingly negative. x→0+ means x approaches zero from the right, and x→0− means from the left. Similarly, y→0+ and y→0− mean approaching zero from above and below.” On the existing y=1/x diagram, model: “As x→∞, y→0+.”
